name: Tahir
source:
Tahir was a member of a rival gang before fate decided to shake up his life. Quick, loyal, and capable, the two of you become fast friends and reliable allies. And perhaps something more?

Friendly with a bit of a sardonic streak and a burgeoning interest in makeup, Tahir is admittedly quite feminine but more than capable of holding his own in a fight, be it verbal or physical.
